roadmap.title: Stage 1 · Migrate profile schema to the new vision model
roadmap.detail: Add migration-safe persistent state for species-wide Flower progression, Bee obtained/mastery stats, Index discovery/read state and Effective Luck. Preserve existing player value and round-trip old profiles safely.

roadmap.title: Stage 2 · Define authoritative progression contracts
roadmap.detail: Make ownership, discovery, obtained-count, Mastery, Garden slot state and settings responsibilities explicit so Inventory, Index, Garden, Roll and Hive all read the same server-authoritative data.

roadmap.title: Stage 1 · Rebuild Garden capacity from 0 to 7 slots
roadmap.detail: New profiles start with 0 Garden slots, tutorial unlocks the first, later slots come from static Hive milestones only, and max capacity is 7.

roadmap.title: Stage 2 · Convert Flower duplicates into species-wide levels
roadmap.detail: Duplicate Flower rolls automatically advance that Flower species. Remove planted-instance progression as the source of permanent Flower level and migrate current slot/copy progress safely.

roadmap.title: Stage 3 · Implement strongest-valid Synergy hierarchy
roadmap.detail: Recipes support exact Flowers and per-Flower level requirements. Only the strongest valid Flower Synergy is active; weaker nested matches do not stack and fallback happens automatically.

roadmap.title: Stage 4 · Add hidden Synergy discovery and ghost hints
roadmap.detail: Undiscovered recipes stay secret. Persist discoveries and show progression-aware ghost suggestions without revealing the recipe name or full solution.

roadmap.title: Stage 5 · Build the confirmed 7-slot Garden editor
roadmap.detail: Author the left Flower list + circular 7-slot editor + current Synergy panel from the saved reference. Choose Flower, choose slot, replace directly, and update the physical Garden immediately.

roadmap.title: Stage 6 · Synchronize Garden UI and world presentation
roadmap.detail: Garden edits must update server state, authored UI and physical flower models consistently, with safe replacement and no loss of species progression.

roadmap.title: Stage 1 · Convert Bee duplicates into species Mastery
roadmap.detail: First Bee unlocks the species. Later copies become Mastery progress and obtained count instead of inventory quantities or dismantle stock.

roadmap.title: Stage 2 · Rebalance species-wide Bee Mastery
roadmap.detail: Move primary Mastery progression away from routine pollination. Define duplicate-driven levels, stat upgrades, ability upgrades and later customization hooks.

roadmap.title: Stage 3 · Rework Bee equipment around owned species
roadmap.detail: Manual Equip/Unequip stays, but equipment must no longer depend on duplicate copy counts. Keep server validation and slot limits.

roadmap.title: Stage 4 · Build TFT-style Trait HUD and tier feedback
roadmap.detail: Left-side Trait list shows icon, name and n1/n2. Hover gives thresholds/effects/member Bees. Tier activation gets a small popup and 1–2 second highlight.

roadmap.title: Stage 5 · Add Trait delta preview to Bee details
roadmap.detail: Before Equip, show how active Trait counts/tiers change, alongside 1/N, Mastery, Traits and ability.

roadmap.title: Stage 1 · Add meaningful Hive Quest requirements
roadmap.detail: Hive upgrades require Honey plus cross-system goals such as discoveries, Mastery, activities or other progression checks instead of Honey alone.

roadmap.title: Stage 2 · Define static Hive milestone rewards
roadmap.detail: Create a fixed reward table shared by all players for Garden slots, Bee slots, Workshop Points and later stat bonuses.

roadmap.title: Stage 3 · Move slot progression fully to Hive milestones
roadmap.detail: Remove Workshop-based Garden/Bee capacity dependencies. Reach all 7 Garden slots around 30% overall progression and preserve existing players safely.

roadmap.title: Stage 1 · Rewrite onboarding Roll sequence
roadmap.detail: Tutorial flow becomes first Garden slot → Flower-only guaranteed Roll → Bee-only guaranteed Roll → normal mixed RNG. Remove the direct starter Bee grant path.

roadmap.title: Stage 2 · Add Effective Luck control
roadmap.detail: Settings defaults to MAX. Player may enter a lower effective Roll Luck, clamped server-side to their real earned maximum without changing build/equipment stats.

roadmap.title: Stage 3 · Align Roll timing with progression
roadmap.detail: Target roughly 4–5 seconds early with fast cruise and pronounced slowdown, then 2–3 seconds after progression upgrades.

roadmap.title: Stage 4 · Build rarity-specific rare reveals
roadmap.detail: Legendary uses premium gold language, Mythic purple/magical, Celestial white-blue/cosmic. Very rare results temporarily suppress most HUD while preserving server-authoritative result flow.

roadmap.title: Stage 1 · Rebuild Inventory data for the new progression model
roadmap.detail: Inventory reads species ownership, 1/N odds, Flower Level, Bee Mastery, Traits and equipment state without relying on obsolete copy-based assumptions.

roadmap.title: Stage 2 · Redesign Inventory cards around 1/N
roadmap.detail: Dense cards prioritize icon, name and large 1/N. Show only a small Level/Mastery badge instead of making xCount and rarity text the main visual.

roadmap.title: Stage 3 · Finish Bee detail and Equip panel
roadmap.detail: Show Equip/Unequip, 1/N, Mastery, Traits, ability and Trait delta preview in the right detail panel.

roadmap.title: Stage 4 · Finish Flower detail and Garden actions
roadmap.detail: Flower detail shows icon/name/1/N/Level and integrates cleanly with the Garden editor without old free-copy/proximity confusion.

roadmap.title: Stage 5 · Integrate Inventory with the compact HUD
roadmap.detail: When Inventory opens, hide Roll. Keep only the intended core HUD: Roll, Inventory, currencies, Trait list and Hive progress.

roadmap.title: Stage 6 · QA Inventory interactions and responsive layout
roadmap.detail: Verify category switching, search/sort, selection, Equip/Unequip, Garden handoff, details and layout at 1920×1080, 1366×768 and 1280×720.

roadmap.title: Stage 1 · Implement Index discovery and read-state backend
roadmap.detail: Add Flowers, Bees, Synergies and Traits payloads, per-category completion, persistent NEW/unread state and Bee obtained counts.

roadmap.title: Stage 2 · Enforce hidden-entry redaction
roadmap.detail: Undiscovered entries are locked empty slots. Do not leak silhouettes, hidden recipe data, member lists or other clues before discovery.

roadmap.title: Stage 3 · Author the fullscreen Index shell
roadmap.detail: Fullscreen Workshop-like focus, vertical category nav on the left, dense small-card grid in the center and right-side details.

roadmap.title: Stage 4 · Implement category-specific detail panels
roadmap.detail: Bee, Flower, Synergy and Trait details must match Q60–Q63 exactly, including 1/N, Mastery, level requirements, tier effects and biome modifier info where applicable.

roadmap.title: Stage 1 · Align Workshop Point sources with Hive progression
roadmap.detail: Workshop Points come from Hive/key milestones instead of being granted automatically every Hive level.

roadmap.title: Stage 2 · Separate stat nodes from major feature nodes
roadmap.detail: Ordinary nodes primarily improve stats; major nodes unlock meaningful mechanics or QoL. Keep the authored fullscreen branching hex tree.

roadmap.title: Stage 3 · Move RESET & REFUND to Biome transition
roadmap.detail: Remove unrestricted normal respec from the intended final flow. Future Biome transition offers KEEP BUILD or RESET & REFUND.

roadmap.title: Stage 1 · Add deterministic migration coverage
roadmap.detail: Test old-profile migration for Flower copies/levels, Bee duplicates/Mastery, Garden slots, tutorial state, Effective Luck and Index read state with no silent value loss.

roadmap.title: Stage 2 · Verify fresh-profile progression reachability
roadmap.detail: Prove 0-slot start, first Flower, first Bee, Hive milestones, Garden capacity and early Workshop access remain reachable and balanced.

roadmap.title: Stage 3 · Run runtime UI acceptance
roadmap.detail: Studio-check Garden, Inventory, Trait HUD, Roll reveals and Index at 1366×768 and 1280×720 with real input/focus behavior.

roadmap.title: Stage 4 · Re-run persistence and rejoin acceptance
roadmap.detail: Join/leave/rejoin must retain all migrated progression and new Index/Settings state. Keep existing RuntimeProbe/PersistenceProbe evidence requirements.

roadmap.title: Stage 1 · Add Biome meta only after the core rebuild
roadmap.detail: Future work: Hive + quest-gated transitions, Trait/Synergy modifiers, new Workshop branches and KEEP BUILD vs RESET & REFUND. Do not prioritize before core vision tasks are stable.
